claims.claimEn: A claimed path is shared across upgrade grids and cannot grant its reward again.
claims.claimZh: 已領取路徑跨升級面板共用，不能換裝備重複領獎。

claims.claimEn: For the historical indexing bug, the author suggests moving the pattern one tile left or right.
claims.claimZh: 針對早期索引問題，作者建議把整個圖樣向左或右移一格。

sources.limitsZh: 未繞過驗證；上述是作者評論，不等於本站實機測試或現行版本保證。原片係由作者公開 YouTube 頻道獨立定位。

sources.title: Hidden Paths (No Spoilers, please)
sources.author: Door-Mateu (comments)

claims.claimEn: The comment reports seven paths: four unrestricted, two requiring green rarity, and one requiring purple rarity.
claims.claimZh: 留言回報共 7 條：4 條不限制稀有度、2 條要求綠色、1 條要求紫色。

claims.claimEn: Cover the path cells; pieces may extend beyond the path and no particular weapon or character is required.
claims.claimZh: 須覆蓋路徑格子，配件可延伸到路徑之外，且不指定武器或角色。

sources.limitsZh: 未標明遊戲版本，也沒有逐條圖樣與獎勵；不得把文字分類硬套到尚未核對的七張圖。
